name: Create a content security rule
description: Create a content security rule Creates a rule that applies a client-side security action when its filter expression matches. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/page_shield/policies
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/page_shield/policies
Creates a rule that applies a client-side security action when its filter expression matches.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a content security rule
